# Graph Store

## Rules
- Abstract `GraphStore(storagePath)` in `domain/ports/`; concrete infrastructure owns schema/layout/backend.
- Persist Files (canonical/project-relative paths, content, category `source|test|ignored`), Symbols, logical symbols/declarations/bindings, Specs, Documents, all relation families, observations, coverage, statistics, VCS ref, fingerprint, generation.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets current logical symbol IDs only; reject missing spec/logical endpoints. Never persist unresolved coverage or reinterpret declaration IDs as logical IDs.
- `open()` explicit, non-destructive; corruption/incompatibility returns typed recoverable error. `close()` idempotent and closed after partial failure.
- `recreate()` requires closed store, replaces persistence, rotates generation, stays closed. `clear()` requires healthy open store, removes every logical artifact/index/fact/observation/latch/fingerprint/ref affecting reindex, preserves generation.
- Providers cache generation at open and detect external replacement before reads.
- `upsertFile(file,symbols,relations)` atomically replaces file slice; failure preserves prior state. `addRelations` additive. `removeFile` atomically removes file, symbols, endpoint relations. Content/category persist; category defaults `source`.
- Query contract covers single/batch/all nodes; dependency, hierarchy, import, coverage reads; symbol queries by name/kind/file/comment/category; exact project-relative file lookup.
- Exact batches `getSymbolsByIds`, `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`: arbitrary order, dedupe first occurrence, omit missing, preserve request order, empty avoids work, no call per identity.
- Batch incoming/outgoing symbol relations accept IDs+types, support dependency/hierarchy families, deterministic source/type/target order, dedupe, omit unknown, empty avoids work, logical batch not per ID/type.
- Batch logical/declaration boundary retrieves declarations by logical IDs, mappings by declaration IDs, and logical/declaration nodes; fields explicitly distinguish identity domains.
- Filtered-impact input carries result types, kinds, workspace inclusion/exclusion, category admission, target, direction, resource, depth. Categories default source; exclusions win; empty inclusion admits all; depth zero supports coverage.
- Backend applies supported relation/kind/category/workspace predicates physically; never return unrestricted candidates for TypeScript filtering. Worker/batch protocols preserve filters.
- Persist structured reference facts: workspace, surface, simple name, symbol space, owner, `MemberSemantics`, declarations, public/local bindings, provenance, coverage. Distinct bindings/routes remain distinct.
- Member lookup uses equality over workspace/surface/name/space/owner/`MemberSemantics`; no `memberForm`. Owned logical symbols persist `qualified_name`; equality lookup returns all matches, without FTS/alias table/canonical-ID parsing.
- Public bindings addressable by surface/exported name/space/target, including cross-workspace target.
- Reverse coverage batches canonical file paths or logical-symbol IDs; deterministic source/type/target order; empty avoids work; logical coverage retains declaration evidence metadata.
- Search symbols/specs/documents prioritizes exact canonical identity, exact primary/alternate name, structured component, then prefix/suffix/substring identity before body-only relevance. Shared lexical expansion preserves originals; splits whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase; more matched identity tokens rank higher.
- Search filters apply before limits; generic full-text retrieval remains. Snippets include 1-based line ranges. `rebuildFtsIndexes()` supports explicit maintenance.
- Source-content candidate query uses persisted `FileNode.content`, normalized/raw/expanded terms, category limit, filters/exclusions, snippet preference. Substring-capable index for ≥3 chars; bounded fallback shorter. Never return all files for application scanning; final merge/provenance/suppression/ranking/grouping/limits stay application-owned.
- Store exposes deterministic complete reference-fact snapshot and batched direct-affected-file query for incremental hydration without per-symbol/relation calls.
- Statistics expose node counts, per-`RelationType` counts, languages, last index time/ref, fingerprint.
- Spec upsert/removal atomically replaces spec-owned dependencies/coverage.
- Indexed observations identify workspace/resource/input/logical locator/hash/stamps or revision/stale flag. Batch compare-and-set prevents pre-reindex assessments mutating new evidence. Per-workspace/global stale latches monotonic; only successful index clears; unknown never persists stale.
- Bulk index: one session, bounded chunks for every node/fact/observation/relation family, batched endpoint/hierarchy validation, dedupe relations across chunks, one atomic commit, one search rebuild; failure exposes no partial generation.
- Incompatible schema rejects reads; authorized repair recreates, rotates generation, fully rebuilds graph/search.

## Constraints
- Abstract class, not interface; backend-neutral contract.
- Closed operations raise `StoreNotOpenError`.
- File-level and logical-generation mutations atomic.
- No prescribed engine, schema, tables, worker messages, filenames, or caller-managed deletion.
- Errors use code-graph hierarchy ending in `SpecdError` from `@specd/core`.
